subtitle: Smart Data Analyzer
privacyText: Files are processed locally on your device.
overviewDesc: Import your data and turn it into clear insights.
welcomeTitle: Turn your data into better decisions
welcomeText: Import an Excel or CSV file to analyze data and create charts and reports while leaving your original files unchanged.
filtersDesc: Apply a filter to update analyses and charts.
quickInsightsDesc: Summary calculated from the current data.
distributionDesc: Most frequent categories in the selected column.
cleanToolsDesc: Preview the impact before applying. Original files are never changed.
trimDesc: Remove extra whitespace from text values.
removeDuplicatesDesc: Keep the first occurrence of each row.
cleanHint: Choose an operation to preview its changes.
statsDesc: Metrics are calculated from filtered records.
pivotDesc: Group by a field and calculate a numeric summary.
dashboardDesc: Create a chart connected to current data and save its settings locally.
dashboardNote: Chart settings are saved on this device only. Global filters affect the chart.
reportsDesc: Create files from the currently filtered data.
qualityReportDesc: Summary of blank cells and duplicate rows.
exportNote: Reports are saved to the folder you choose. Arabic shaping in PDFs depends on available fonts.
noData: No data loaded. Import a file first.
noNumeric: No suitable numeric columns for this chart.
cleanDone: Changes were applied to the working copy.
demoDataNotice: You are exploring sample sales data. Filters and changes apply to this session only.
demoRibbon: Demo version with ready-to-explore sample data
demoImportDisabled: Import is disabled in this demo. Sample sales data is already loaded.
